name: High Tight Flag Failure
rule: prior strong gain + tight flag + close below flag low

name: Support Test Count Overload
rule: touches of support in last15 >=3 and rebounds shrinking

name: Distribution Volume Spike
rule: sum(vol on down days last7)/sum(vol last7)>0.58 and vol7>vol20

name: Gap Fill Failure
rule: close below gap_fill_level after touching it

name: Momentum Divergence 14D
rule: price makes higher high while RSI/MACD histogram lower high

name: Lower High On Higher Volume
rule: swing_high lower than prior swing_high and volume higher

name: FiftyDMA Rejection
rule: high crosses 50DMA but close below 50DMA twice in 10 days

name: Failed Breakout Within 5D
rule: breakout close above resistance then close below resistance within 5 days

name: False Reclaim Trap
rule: close above support then close below within 3D

name: Double Bottom Right Side Strength
rule: second_low near first_low but CLV higher and volume lower/same

name: Three Day Failed Selloff
rule: 3-day low undercut + close above day1 close by day3

name: Oversold To Neutral Fast
rule: RSI14 crosses above 45 from below 35 within 5 sessions

name: Failed Breakdown 3D Confirm
rule: close reclaims broken support within 3 days after breakdown

name: ATR Percentile Bottom 20
rule: ATR14 percentile over 252 days <= 20 and price above 20D low

name: Stealth Accumulation Flat Price Rising OBV
Absorption At Resistance
rule: close within 2% of 20D high and volume>1.3*vol20 and no close below mid

name: Bollinger Bandwidth 10D Squeeze
rule: bandwidth=(upper20-lower20)/ma20; flag if bandwidth percentile <= 15 over 6M

name: Accumulation Without Gap
rule: positive CLV + rising OBV + no gap >3% last10

name: Micro Pullback In Base
rule: drawdown from 10D high between -2% and -6%, no 10D low break

name: Two Green High-CLV Days In Base
rule: count(close>open and CLV>0.7 last5)>=2 and no breakout close yet

name: Last Red Day Volume Shrink
rule: volume on down days last5 < avg volume down days prior20

name: Range Contraction 3-Step
rule: range_t < range_t-1 < range_t-2 and close not breaking 10D low

name: NR14 Compression Before Break
rule: flag if today's high-low <= MIN(high-low over 14 sessions)

name: Higher Low With Volume Support
rule: latest_swing_low > prior_swing_low and pullback volume <= avg volume

name: Breakout Pressure Ratio
rule: avg(CLV last5) > avg(CLV prior5) and CLV=(close-low)/(high-low)

name: Close Recovery Same Day
rule: day_low_breaks_prior_low and close>open or close>midrange, count>=2 last7

name: Base Break Volume Preview
rule: vol3/vol20 between 1.15 and 1.6 while price below breakout

name: NR7 Day Inside 10D Base
rule: range_today = high-low; flag if range_today <= MIN(range[-7:]) and close within 10D range midpoint band
